# Бризекс

> Russian e-commerce platform for purchasing and installing air breathers (приточная вентиляция) with nationwide delivery across Russia.

Brizeks specializes in supply and professional installation of residential air breather systems from leading manufacturers including TION, Ballu, Royal Clima, and ATMEEX. The company operates service centers in Moscow and St. Petersburg with delivery capabilities throughout Russia.

## Key Topics

- Air breathers (бризеры)
- HEPA filtration (H11, F7)
- PM2.5 air purification
- Smart home integration
- Professional installation service
- TION breathers
- Ballu ONEAIR series
- Royal Clima BREZZA
- ATMEEX AIRNANNY
- Приточная вентиляция (supply ventilation)
- Moscow & St. Petersburg service
- Russia-wide delivery
- Indoor air quality
- Virus protection technology
- Quiet operation
